scope: Read-only independent audit of settled actual X01 inputs, own receipts, raw result, embedded and on-disk bytes; no engine rerun or qualification override.
limitations: not_calibrated; no measured ground truth or engine-accuracy winner.
One run per engine; no statistical p50/p95, performance ranking or uncertainty estimate.
Same seed does not imply the same engine noise stream; this study disables noise and stochastic actors.
Source journal governs mission, confirmation and served; the trajectory supplies drive geometry only.
Nominal runs do not exercise cancellation or unknown-ACK handling; absent triggers are not_run.
Contact, slip and tipping are unsupported by IR-SIM. Byte hashes establish input integrity, not producer trust or human acceptance.

Arrival measurement: drive-frame pose at Source MissionArrived; acceptance checks that tick and preceding 4 recorded ticks against bound policy position 0.05 m, yaw 0.05 rad, stopped linear 0.01 m/s and angular 0.02 rad/s. Cross-engine differences within these constraints do not imply an accuracy winner.
